backtest.note: Model over-leans on CFB passing yards went 25-56 as picks Nov 5-17; the UNDER fade won 69%.

Model-favoured side (model_prob > 0.5, any tier) on CFB rushing yards, Nov 10-17: 60.9% vs 52.7% quoted, ROI +14.3%, 95% CI (+1.4%, +27.3%). Both sides win — no side restriction. The edge lives in tier-'none' rows (model_prob 0.50-0.55, +18.3%, n=176); tier-lean rows (>= 0.55) lost -33% (n=14), so the selector takes model-favoured rows of ANY tier, mildest leans first. One Saturday (Nov 14, 152/192 rows) dominates the number; the 3-pick subset edge is unproven and Nov 21 is its first live test.
Model over-leans on CFB totals went 16-32 as picks Nov 5-17; the UNDER fade went 32-16.
Model A underdog golds went 3-19 as picks; fading them (betting the favorite) went 19-3.

Next-man-up starter overs at plus money, Nov 6-17: 57.5% hit, ROI +28.4%, 95% CI (+10.3%, +46.6%). Usage redistributes to starters already on the floor when a teammate is out; the edge is freshest on the first absence and dies by absence #3.
